title: Repair Dependabot CI baseline
summary: Repair the shared Dependabot CI baseline: provision release tools in Phase 1, eliminate generated drift, synchronize Local API inventories and Tauri routes, restore strict staged-packet coverage, refresh stale tests/fixtures, and make generated package context match intentional release exclusions without weakening safety policy.
reason: Open dependency-update pull requests inherit CI failures from stale generated contracts, missing CI provisioning, outdated inventory/test expectations, and workstation-path package policy violations rather than dependency changes themselves.
behavior_before: Release-capable workflows did not consistently provision bundled Python/media tools; route inventories, the Tauri route mirror, WebView artifacts, and several tests lagged the current Local API and safety semantics; two historical packets exposed operator-local paths.
behavior_after: CI provisions and verifies the same bundled runtime/tool prerequisites, contract mirrors and generated evidence are current, UI actions remain backend-allowlisted, tests assert current safety behavior, retained validation evidence redacts local paths, and release packages regenerate generated indexes after applying exclusion policy while workflow-only tests remain active in source/CI.
manual_validation: Change-packet validation and strict worktree coverage passed after restoring the verified MP-CHANGE-2026-0707-001 record and recording generated-summary paths exactly.

Clean package build passed with -Zip -Verify -IncludeTests under an isolated LOCALAPPDATA configuration; the artifact regenerated PROJECT_INDEX and FEATURE_FILE_MAP after exclusions and reported no skipped or downshifted validation gates.

Clean source-tree release self-test passed with -RequireTests under an isolated LOCALAPPDATA configuration; desktop, core, and tooling test suites plus generated, tool-integration, WebView, and end-to-end gates passed.
Final clean package build with -Zip -Verify -IncludeTests passed after restoring MP-CHANGE-2026-0707-001; package validation reported no skipped or downshifted gates.
Focused Python and PowerShell regression checks passed, including release package scope, audit manifest, CI provisioning, private-beta workflow contracts, and release package policy checks.

An earlier strict-coverage attempt exposed the null-filled MP-CHANGE-2026-0707-001.json record; restoring its verified JSON and recording every generated-summary path resolved that condition, and final exact coverage passes for all 986 packets.
npm run webview:lint, npm run webview:prework:check, npm run check --prefix apps/desktop/tauri, phase1 generated audits, and PSScriptAnalyzer checks passed.

Refreshed 2026-07-10 validation passed: focused historical Python regressions, all generated/WebView checks, clean source release self-test with -RequireTests, clean package build with -Zip -Verify -IncludeTests, and git diff --check; package validation reported no skipped gates.
rollback_plan: Revert the workflow, contract, UI, inventory, test, and redaction changes in this packet; regenerate the generated summaries and WebView artifacts; then rerun the targeted and release gates before reintroducing any prior behavior.
